finding.text: There is no `requirements.md` in the task folder. The only one is `item-read/requirements.md`, which briefs the child task (the `read` parameter in `Servex/agents/page_tools.js`), and `review/diff.patch` touches none of that. The round-6 header/tabs/settings ask exists only as the "Changing today" bullets in `public/live/readme.md:74-80`. Write the owner's round-6 ask into `requirements.md` as numbered items, in the owner's words, so the work can be checked against it.

The diff is not in the tree I reviewed. `grep` finds 0 hits for `Tabs`, `tabs_of` and `settings_of` in `public/live/LivePage.js`, and `public/live/readme.md:58` and `:74-80` still carry the old text ("Saved screens" in the footer, "Changing today (round 6)"). Commit `429985390` ("keep compliance/dev's live readme") may have dropped it, or it was never landed; `git status` shows only `public/live/page.jsonl` staged. Re-apply and land `LivePage.js`, `LivePage.css` and `readme.md`, then record the commit in the session record.

`public/live/LivePage.test.mjs` is not in the diff, so `title_of`, `tabs_of`, the `settings` route and the `tab_skip` set have no test. These are pure async functions over a listing and are easy to cover.

`LivePage.js` (the diff's `Tabs.render`, around line 233) adds `add` and `remove` listeners to `top.screens` on every Tabs instance and never removes them. The `ResizeObserver` is never disconnected either. Navigating between pages inside the single-page app stacks listeners, and each one calls `draw()` on a detached view. Unbind them when the view is destroyed, or have one shared listener redraw the current Tabs.

`title_of` (`LivePage.js`, diff line ~115) caches a failed fetch forever. A transient `fetch` failure or a listing that hasn't loaded yet caches the folder name for the rest of the load, so tab labels would keep disagreeing with the h1, which is the "one title everywhere" ask. Also, a title set later by `item({path, delta:{title}})` never updates an open tab or preview card because the Map is never invalidated. Don't cache a null result, and drop the entry when the page's own title changes.

The new "Settings" route shadows any card or sub-page named `settings` (`route()` in the diff, line ~95). The readme admits this, but `tab_skip` and `settings` are hard-coded, so a folder `/live/settings/` would silently disappear from the tabs. Give the real folder or screen priority: the check order in `route()` puts `settings` before screens, and `super.route` runs first only for folders.

The other docs that still describe the footer's "Pages here" and "Saved screens" are not in the diff. `public/live/doc/page-features.md` and `doc/notes.md` are the likely ones. Grep them and fix them when item 2 lands, so a fresh agent isn't told about a footer that no longer exists.

The header sets `margin-top: -.75rem` to cancel the page padding, in `LivePage.css:~28`. That is a magic number tied to the `.live-page` padding, so it breaks silently if the padding changes. A `--live-pad` variable shared by both would be safer.

The `shots/` folder has `live-400-light.png`, `nav-top-400.png`, `r4-lab-400.png` and others, but there is no `layout.json` or sheet for the header. The "under 100 px at every depth and width" claim is therefore unmeasured. I did not check the shots against it.

The `item-read` child task has its own proof (a 4 KB cut, `class_of` loading `LivePage`, tests). Its landing is not visible in this diff. Check `item-read/session.jsonl` for a landing line and the restart note before calling the parent done.

requirements.md still lists only the 11 round-6 asks; the diff is the follow-on task `live-all-livepage` ("every page under /live/ is a LivePage, header full width with a border"), whose ask is nowhere in the task folder except its one-line `why` in session.jsonl. Add it as ask 12 (with the owner's words or a link to the voice-app record) so a fresh agent can check the diff against it.

session.jsonl has an `add` line for `live-all-livepage` but no `complete` line, no evidence, and no proof for the new behaviour; the only newest shots (shots/r8-live-demos-tabs-page-400.png, r8-live-lab-is-page-400.png) are not tied to the task or to the header height claim (under 100 px with the new border). Log the completion with the probe result and shot names.

No test covers the two new static/instance overrides (public/live/LivePage.js:126-141, `log_class` and `child`). A plain-Page page.jsonl, a no-class page.jsonl and a DesignPage each need one assertion, since this changes how every page under /live/ is built.

Every folder under /live/ is now forced into a LivePage, including ones that were deliberately not tabs (/live/sessions/, /live/archive/, /live/v1/, design-tmp). The diff does not say whether those still render; check each (v1 especially) and either exempt them or note in public/live/readme.md that they now carry the header.

`child()` at public/live/LivePage.js:129-139 copies the `child_kinds === "jsonl"` branch of Page.child (core/Page/Page.class.js:382) just to call `LivePage.jsonl` instead of `Page.jsonl`. Simpler: have core's branch use `this.constructor.jsonl(...)` (a one-line core change, but it touches a core API, so ask first) and drop the override.

The new CSS (LivePage.css:29-37) sets the header's side padding with `max(0px, (100% - 60rem) / 2)`; a percentage in padding resolves against the page's width, which is correct here only because the header is a direct child. Worth a one-line comment saying so, and a wide-screen shot (3440) to confirm; the shots folder only has 400/1200/1920.
readme.md (public/live/readme.md:84-85) documents the change accurately; no unindexed file in the diff.
